T: Big mistake. Huge. Order the strawberries.
D: A businessman hires a woman for a week in Beverly Hills and they fall for each other.
P: Serve the strawberries and bubbles when Edward orders them up to the penthouse.
S: Chilled ripe strawberries with sugar for dipping, cold sparkling wine alongside
The ripest strawberries you can find, washed, dried properly and chilled, piled in a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. A very cold bottle of bubbles alongside.
Baked in garlic, shallot and brandy butter until sizzling, snails or mushroom caps

Escargot or button mushrooms tucked into a dish, each covered with butter mashed with garlic, parsley, shallot and a splash of brandy, baked at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Bread for the butter.

Warm little blini topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill and salmon roe, alongside cucumber cups of whipped goat's cheese and chives. Warm 16 blini at 180C for 4 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon from 150g, a little salmon roe and dill. Beat 150g goat's cheese with 2 tbsp cream, lemon zest and chopped chives. Cut a telegraph cucumber into 3cm rounds, scoop a hollow in each and pipe in the goat's cheese.
M: Business dinner eye fillet and red wine jus
Seared eye fillet in red wine jus, with creamy potato gratin

Eye fillet seared and roasted pink, with a glossy red wine and shallot jus, creamy potato gratin and buttered green beans. Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream, a crushed garlic clove and salt, and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Sear an 800g eye fillet on all sides, roast at 200C to 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Soften 2 chopped shallots, add 250ml red wine and reduce by half, then add 300ml beef stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in 20g butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.
ordering everything off the room service menu

Three-tier toasted club of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, with a silver bowl of shoestring fries. Grill 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread. Spread with mayo and layer across three slices each: 400g sliced roast chicken, bacon, lettuce and sliced tomato. Pin each sandwich with 4 toothpicks and cut into 4 triangles. Bake 800g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes and salt well.
W: Strawberries dipped in dark chocolate with a white chocolate drizzle
Strawberries dried completely, dipped in tempered dark chocolate, set on baking paper, then drizzled with thin lines of melted white chocolate.
K: Champagne over a bitters soaked sugar cube with a splash of brandy

A sugar cube soaked in bitters at the bottom of a flute, a splash of brandy, topped with cold champagne and a twist of orange. Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket for 30 minutes. Drop a sugar cube into each of four flutes and soak with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Add 15ml brandy to each, then slowly top with champagne. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
